description: This source file provides utility functions related to opening files with retry logic on EINTR and cloexec support, typically used within the Git project for ensuring reliable and secure file opening operations.

methods.name: int git_open_with_retry(const char * path,int flags,...)
methods.description: Attempts to open a file with specified flags, retrying if interrupted by a signal (EINTR). Supports variadic mode argument when O_CREAT is used.

methods.name: int git_open_cloexec(const char * name,int flags)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor with close-on-exec flag set, fallback to retry without O_CLOEXEC if unsupported.
